summary: Remove the field from Django state only, retire the old version, then drop the column.

stages.description: No schema change is needed; make sure the column accepts NULL for new-app inserts.
sql: ALTER TABLE account_user ALTER COLUMN note DROP NOT NULL

stages.description: Deploy the new version; its migration only updates Django state.
Drop the column once no version reads it.
sql: ALTER TABLE account_user DROP COLUMN note
